name: dsh-companion
description: 独立运行的 Agent Pet（小鑫），默认接入 DSH，可自动检测并按需接入本机各类 AI Agent

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/session-view.js && node --check connectors/catalog.cjs && node --check connectors/registry.cjs && node --check connectors/opencode/agent-pet.js && node --check runtime/main.cjs && node --check runtime/placement.cjs && node --check runtime/preload.cjs && node --check runtime/manager-preload.cjs && node --check runtime/manager.js && node --check runtime/ui.js && node --check runtime/activity-notices.js && node --check src/client.js && node --check runtime/audio.js && node --check runtime/local-speech.cjs && node --check runtime/providers.cjs && node --check runtime/hook-state.cjs && node --check runtime/workbuddy-state.cjs && node --check runtime/codex-sessions.cjs && node --check runtime/notch.cjs && node --check scripts/start.cjs && python3 -m py_compile connectors/hooks/emit.py connectors/workbuddy/emit.py connectors/antigravity/emit.py connectors/codex/emit.py scripts/install.py
scripts.build:notch: mkdir -p bin bin/AgentPetSpeech.app/Contents/MacOS && xcrun swiftc runtime/NotchPanel.swift -o bin/notch-panel && xcrun swiftc scripts/screen-info.swift -o bin/screen-info && xcrun swiftc scripts/speech-helper.swift -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker scripts/speech-info.plist -o bin/speech-helper && cp bin/speech-helper bin/AgentPetSpeech.app/Contents/MacOS/speech-helper && cp scripts/speech-info.plist bin/AgentPetSpeech.app/Contents/Info.plist && codesign --force -s - bin/speech-helper && codesign --force --deep -s - bin/AgentPetSpeech.app
